models.provider: Azure Foundry (naia-azure-foundry, koreacentral, GlobalStandard), OpenAI-compatible v1 chat/completions, bearer auth

embedding.prefixes: passages via embedBatch ('passage: '), queries via embed ('query: ') for both simple-vector and naia arms
embedding.reopen_in_simple_vector: declared no-op (append-only index), as in candidate-e
embedding.provider_request_caps: embedding is local and not counted toward provider caps; it is inside wall time

tokenizer.claim: not claimed identical to the model tokenizers
tokenizer.memory_context_budget: 1024 o200k tokens, local only (cannot be verified from usage)
tokenizer.answer_prompt_ceiling_rule: an answer row whose usage.prompt_tokens > 8192 is budget-failure and stays in the denominator
tokenizer.reported: median and max of |local - usage.prompt_tokens| / usage.prompt_tokens over answer rows; above 10% is marked a measurement limit, not a failure
tokenizer.judge_preflight: o200k x 1.3 <= 16000 per batch or the batch is split to 2 then 1 rows, decided before dispatch
tokenizer.no_pairing_with_first_run: token counts are not compared with the Gemini native counts of candidate-e

budget_caps.usd: not estimated: Azure credit with no bound list price source; token caps are the binding limits
budget_caps.on_cap: requests past a cap are refused locally and recorded; affected rows are failures in the denominator; report INCOMPLETE if any cap is reached; caps are not raised

retries.transport_retry: one retry for 5xx or deadline only, both receipts kept; the product extractor's internal 5xx loop is capped to two physical attempts by the transport
retries.rejudging: none; the judge stage refuses to run twice
retries.refusal_codes: 498 = local cap refusal, 499 = transport retry cap refusal; the product extractor classifies both as http failures, which this registration maps to the transport class

extraction_failure_gate.primary_metric: failed physical extraction calls / physical extraction calls (expected 42)
extraction_failure_gate.empty_facts: a schema-valid response with no facts is not an extraction failure; it flows into answer metrics
extraction_failure_gate.meaning: necessary condition for accepting the extractor path only; the answer correctness gates must also pass

judge_rules.blinding: opaque blind ids (sha256 of run id and row id); arm identity and row ids are never sent
judge_rules.batching: 4 rows of one hidden arm per batch, split before dispatch by the size preflight
judge_rules.gold_access: judge opens gold only after verifying the capture seal (capture.jsonl and capture-meta.json sha256)
judge_rules.batch_unavailable: transport failure, finish_reason length, invalid JSON, id coverage mismatch, or a declared field with the wrong type make the whole batch unavailable-judge. Undeclared fields are recorded and ignored.
judge_rules.row_unavailable: an evidence quote that is not a whitespace-normalized substring of the row's supplied texts makes that row unavailable-judge
judge_rules.unavailable_effect: Execution failures (engine, transport, parse, budget) are definite incorrect answers. Judge-unavailable rows with a successful execution are uncertain: correctness is reported as a lower bound (uncertain counted incorrect) and an upper bound (uncertain counted correct). Gate: lower bound >= threshold is PASS for that check, upper bound < threshold is FAIL, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Leak/overwrite/reversal checks: any observed > 0 is FAIL; otherwise any unavailable is INCONCLUSIVE.
judge_rules.false_overwrite: each row carries false_overwrite_applies = native state available AND gold denominators.false_overwrite. The judge returns a boolean only when it applies, otherwise null. A null where it applies is unavailable for that metric on that row only; a boolean where it does not apply is discarded.
judge_rules.projection: question, query context, retrieved items as {rank, content, project} without engine kind labels, recovered context with [fact]/[episode] prefixes removed, recent tail, candidate answer text, native active state as fact lifecycle list {id, content, status, project, validFrom, validTo, supersedes} (full store is not sent), source events, gold propositions and query gold. Evidence quote texts include active-state fact contents.
judge_rules.fields_derivation: The twelve booleans plus false_overwrite, reason and evidence_quotes are candidate-e's fixed row contract (RUBRIC_CONTRACT.memory). forbidden_asserted, retrieval_critical_reversal and answer_critical_reversal split rubric answer_fields.correct and critical_reversal into the surfaces rubric memory_denominators.critical_reversal asks to report separately.
judge_rules.request_caps: judge stage has its own cap of 300 requests

answer_prompt.system_exact: Answer only from the supplied recent conversation and retrieved memory or recap. Preserve project and time distinctions. If the value is unknown, deleted, cancelled or undecided, say so; do not invent it. Return JSON mapping question IDs to concise answers in the question language. Return a JSON object {"answers": {"<question id>": "<answer>"}}.
answer_prompt.user_template:
QUESTION_ID <id>
QUESTION: <text>
RETRIEVED MEMORY:
<one line per supplied item: '- <content>', or (none)>
RECENT CONVERSATION:
<role: content lines>
answer_prompt.parse_rule: answers[<question id>] must be a string; otherwise status parse-failure (execution failure, denominator kept, incorrect)
answer_prompt.item_prefix: neutral '- ' for all arms (candidate-e used [fact]/[episode], an arm-dependent label; changed on Fable recommendation before freezing). The 1024-token context budget is counted on this text.

gold_access_note: verifyDesign hashes every design file including gold bytes but does not parse gold in capture
judge_prompt_unchanged: judge input construction is byte-identical to az1 for the same capture content; the judge already receives question.mode and query_context.at_timestamp

owner_decisions.2026-09-15: Luke: '우선 한국어에 집중해서 증명 해줬으면 좋겠어', '관련한 목표와 상세계획 세우고, 이 계획에 따라 진행하고 루프를 확인', '잘 진행해줘'. Plan: reports/quality/ko-heldout-20260915/PLAN.md

scope: Korean only. 84 sealed held-out cases authored by a model with no repository access (deepseek-v4-flash) from a brief; curated by mechanical checks and reviewer rejections without hand edits. Cloud extraction/answer path (Azure). Synthetic, not real user logs. Not local-model evidence.

design.rubric: unchanged copy of the development rubric

candidate-ko-before-20260915.worktree: ko-before detached at 70dc147 with runner copied in

candidate-ko-after-20260915.product: same-episode rule, category identity, value-less and string deletion rules, delete diagnostics, episode exclude filter
candidate-ko-after-20260915.extraction: replayed from the sealed before-run file; the runner asserts it matches that run's seal
candidate-ko-after-20260915.worktree: filter-az6a detached at a0dd0b5 with runner copied in

arms.simple-vector: append-only raw turns, e5 embeddings; product-independent, used as noise reference between the two runs
arms.naia-llm-filter: LocalAdapter with the product GeminiFlashLiteContradictionFilter class pointed at Azure gpt-5-4-nano (a proxy for the product LLM filter path; its prompt was written for Gemini). Different model from the judge (deepseek-v4-flash)
arms.shared: both naia arms consume one extraction response per case; delete verification is live per arm

invalidity: before run: physical extraction calls != 84, or extraction call failures beyond the extraction gate
after run: extraction not replayed 84/84 from the sealed before file (runner aborts on a miss)
either run: extractionPerCase census check false (both naia arms consume one extraction per case)
naia-llm-filter: zero contradiction-filter calls in a run, or any heuristic fallback (runner aborts)
product src differs from the registered commit, or runner/design/analysis-script sha mismatch

primary_metric.name: fact state by rule-based judgement (factstate.py, calibrated on az3/az5b/az4 development runs: no disagreement with human listings on judged cases)
primary_metric.case_error: a case has an error when it has wrong_supersession, deletion_not_applied or wrong_archive; not_superseded is reported separately
primary_metric.comparison: after minus before, per contradiction-filter path (naia, naia-llm-filter), paired by case
primary_metric.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over the 14 construction families (6 cases each), seed 20260915, 10,000 resamples, 95% interval of the difference in case-error count
primary_metric.wording: interval excludes 0 in the predicted direction -> 'improvement observed'; includes 0 -> 'no difference shown'
primary_metric.hard_condition: after-run wrong_archive = 0 in both naia arms
primary_metric.judgement_order: factstate output committed before score.json is opened
primary_metric.calibration: factstate on az3/az5b/az4 development captures: no disagreement with human listings on judged cases (not_superseded had no human counterpart); az4 deletion_applied 6 matches human archives except ja-06 (stored in English, reported as obsolete_not_stored). Development-exposed, so calibration only.

secondary_metric.name: answer-level current correctness, deletion leakage, stale exposure (unchanged judge and rubric)
secondary_metric.comparison: after minus before per path, cluster bootstrap as above
secondary_metric.judge_validity: judge verdicts count as evidence only if the Korean human review (stage 1, 38 items) shows at least 90% agreement on correctness; otherwise answer-level results are reported as provisional
secondary_metric.noise_reference: simple-vector answer and verdict changes between the two runs (its context is identical by construction)

by_variant_after_vs_before.new/stable, new/deadline: wrong_supersession decreases (category identity rule) when the extractor gives the two facts different labels under one category id; when it gives the same label the error remains (registered residual)
by_variant_after_vs_before.update/correction, update/chain: correct supersession kept; not_superseded does not increase
by_variant_after_vs_before.delete/forget: deletion_applied increases and deletion_not_applied decreases (label grounding and string-exact candidates); cases whose delete wording does not name the property literally, or whose target quote is not in the stored fact content, may stay unapplied; obsolete_not_stored is reported separately and not counted as applied
by_variant_after_vs_before.delete/cancel_one: deletion_not_applied unchanged (already reachable before); wrong_archive decreases (same-episode rule)
by_variant_after_vs_before.preferences/coexist: no systematic change (labels are often identical; registered extraction residual)
by_variant_after_vs_before.history/at_time: excluded from wrong_supersession; answers expected to fail in every naia arm (registered unsupported at-time path)
by_variant_after_vs_before.project_isolation/delete_one: deletion_applied increases; wrong_archive of the other project stays 0

predictions.path: the improvement on naia-llm-filter is expected in the same direction but smaller: the LLM filter decides same-subject replacements through fallbackFacts, which the category rule does not govern
predictions.answers: deletion_leakage decreases in the after run (episode exclude filter plus applied deletions); current correctness not lower beyond noise

interpretation_lock: Fact-state differences between runs are attributed to the product change (identical extraction by replay); live delete verification and the LLM filter are part of each product path and reported with receipts. Answer-level differences are attributed only when the judge passes stage 1 and the cluster interval excludes 0.
review: Fable 2026-09-15: fixed and executable after applying deletion_applied/obsolete_not_stored with reseal, registered compare.py, scope_limits, runner sha
fallback_detection: The LLM filter class has two catch branches (callLLMOrFallback and the vLLM batch path), both of which console.warn a '[...ContradictionFilter]' message before falling back; the runner counts these and aborts, and separately counts non-200 filter receipts. A response with missing per-pair entries is treated by the product as 'no contradiction' without a warning; that is product behaviour, not a fallback.
recorded_not_invalidating: delete verification physical call counts per run and arm

scope_limits.synthetic_cloud: Synthetic cases; cloud extraction/answer/judge models; no local-model measurement.
scope_limits.author_judge_family: The case author (deepseek-v4-flash) is the same model family as the judge.
scope_limits.llm_filter_proxy: naia-llm-filter uses the product filter class with a prompt written for Gemini, sent to gpt-5-4-nano; a proxy for the product LLM path. The filter model differs from the judge.
scope_limits.delete_verification_live: Delete verification is live in both runs and treated as part of each product path; receipts reported separately.
scope_limits.bundle_effect: The after product bundles five changes (same-episode rule, category identity, value-less and string deletion rules, delete diagnostics, episode exclude filter); results are the bundle's effect, not per-rule attribution.
scope_limits.at_time: history/at_time 6 cases use the registered unsupported at-time path.
scope_limits.factstate_limits: Rule-based matching misses values stored in another surface form or language (reported as unmatched); Korean date and 천/만 amount forms are converted.
scope_limits.curation: 20 rows were replaced by mechanical checks and 16 by reviewer rejections before sealing; residuals kept: identical question text in cases 36/37, a weak hint in case 38, project name '솔솔' containing a banned development name.
scope_limits.cancel_one_second_question: cancel_one second questions name the cancelled item with the answer 'no', as in the development design (not a leak).
scope_limits.real_names: A few real brand or title names appear as user-owned values.
